data.body:
[P2] Return the notification feature to design review

The description announces the shared workflow and its pin but provides no design note covering the problem, cause, simpler alternatives, chosen rationale, and removals. This breaks rule 3, **Write a design note before the code**, including the simplification assessment required by rule 2. The implementation-PR reference does not identify an approved design note, leaving the approach unreviewed against those requirements. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and obtain maintainer agreement on that note before continuing.
